presetNotes: Remember to prepot overload, weapon poison+++, kwuarm and lantadyme sticks, and if doing more advanced tech also build a few leng stacks. On are dummy in the boss arena we will use a dragon battle-axe. The first hit we use on telos will be our dragon scimitar spec
